 What’s Open and Closed on Veterans Day 2026 in New Jersey
 Colleen Petrucci 
 Published Nov 9, 2026 
 Veterans Day falls on Wednesday, Nov. 11, this year, and in New Jersey it closes the post office, state offices and the MVC while most stores stay open. Here is what is open and closed, checked against each agency’s own schedule.
 What’s Open and Closed on Veterans Day 2026 in New Jersey
 Service 
 Wednesday, Nov. 11 
 Post offices and mail delivery 
 Closed, no regular mail 
 UPS 
 Open 
 FedEx 
 Modified service 
 Federal Reserve and most banks 
 Closed 
 TD Bank 
 Closed 
 Stock market (NYSE) 
 Open 
 Bond market 
 Closed 
 New Jersey state offices 
 Closed 
 MVC agencies and inspection stations 
 Closed 
 NJ Transit 
 Holiday schedule 
 Public schools 
 Depends on the district 
 Trash and recycling 
 Depends on the town 
 Most stores, restaurants and supermarkets 
 Open 
 Is the Post Office Open on Veterans Day?
 No. All post offices close on Wednesday, Nov. 11, and regular mail delivery and retail service pick up again on Thursday, Nov. 12, according to the Postal Service . Self-service kiosks in some lobbies and usps.com still work for stamps, labels and Hold Mail.
 Packages can still move that day. UPS keeps running on Veterans Day, since it isn’t on the UPS holiday list, and FedEx runs a modified service, according to its 2026 holiday schedule. Our guide to USPS holidays in 2026 and 2027 has every postal holiday and the Christmas mailing dates.
 The Veterans Memorial in Brigantine, November 2025. Photo by Mr. Matté, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. 
 Are Banks Open on Veterans Day?
 Most banks close, because Veterans Day is on the Federal Reserve’s holiday schedule. That includes TD Bank, which opens on some federal holidays but lists its stores as closed on Veterans Day in its 2026 holiday schedule . ATMs, mobile banking and online banking keep working, though payments made that day may not process until Thursday.
 The stock market stays open. The New York Stock Exchange doesn’t list Veterans Day among its 2026 market holidays, while the bond market closes for the day on the recommendation of SIFMA, the industry group that sets its schedule.
 New Jersey State Offices, the MVC and NJ Transit
 Veterans Day is a New Jersey state holiday, so state offices close, according to the state’s holiday list. The MVC closes its facilities too, which takes in licensing centers, vehicle centers and inspection stations, so any MVC errand has to wait until Thursday or go online.
 NJ Transit runs on a holiday schedule on Veterans Day, according to its holiday service page , so trains and buses may not follow the usual weekday timetable. Check your route before you leave.
 Veterans Day is one of 13 days state offices close in 2026, and Election Day earlier this month was another. Our list of New Jersey state holidays has the rest.
 Schools and Trash Pickup
 There is no single answer for schools. Each New Jersey district sets its own calendar, and many South Jersey districts already gave students days off earlier this month for the teachers’ convention, so check your district’s 2026-27 calendar before Wednesday.
 Trash and recycling pickup is set town by town as well. Some towns collect as normal on Veterans Day and others move pickup back a day, so look at your town’s website or recycling calendar.

 Towns across Atlantic and Cape May counties are holding ceremonies this week, according to the list compiled by Shore Local . All are open to the public.

 Beyond Veterans Day, the state’s Department of Military and Veterans Affairs holds medal ceremonies for veterans around New Jersey through the year, like the one at the Cherry Hill Mall below.

 Frequently Asked Questions About Veterans Day 2026
 Is mail delivered on Veterans Day?
 No. Regular mail isn’t delivered on Wednesday, Nov. 11, and service resumes on Thursday, Nov. 12.
 Is Veterans Day a federal holiday?
 Yes. Federal offices, post offices and the Federal Reserve close, and in New Jersey it is a state holiday as well.
 Is the MVC open on Veterans Day?
 No. MVC facilities in New Jersey, including inspection stations, close on Veterans Day and reopen on Thursday.
 Is UPS open on Veterans Day?
 Yes. UPS picks up and delivers as normal on Veterans Day, and FedEx runs a modified service.
 What tax breaks do New Jersey veterans get?
 A $6,000 exemption on the state income tax, a $250 yearly deduction on the property tax bill for veterans who own their home, and a full property tax exemption on the home of a 100% disabled veteran, according to the Division of Taxation .
 Are schools closed on Veterans Day in New Jersey?
 Some are and some aren’t, because each district sets its own calendar. Check your district’s website.
